reason: Conversation 2 correctly led with the 'key detected as held' explanation, told the homeowner to dry the panel and power-cycle at the isolator in a single efficient turn, set the safety boundary (no casing removal), and closed with sensible prevention advice plus a clear escalation rule if E011 recurs on a dry panel. Conversation 1 floated the unsupported 'temperature sensor' meaning, only latched onto moisture after the customer volunteered it, and wrongly framed the final diagnosis as a 'short circuit in the control electronics' with no guidance on recurrence or future cleaning. Both reached the right no-part outcome, but 2 was more accurate, more proactive and more complete.
